items.text: Saquon Barkley (previously EXPECTED TO PLAY per ETR) confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys; Rapoport corroborated with Dickerson/Stowers also up.
items.why: Cleared for MNF after prior uncertainty
items.implication: RB1 workload locked in; Eagles also activated TEs Stowers/Calcaterra

items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pre-game; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed he was officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury after Saturday improvement and no setbacks.
items.why: Rams optimistic Saturday; feeling better, available barring setbacks
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; Adams already out elevates target share

items.text: ETR flagged Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM; Schefter and Rapoport confirmed officially INACTIVE (quad strain, limited practice, early return risk). Fourth straight miss.
items.why: Not full participant; medical caution after three misses
items.implication: Continue monitoring Week 8 practice; role may be shared on return

items.text: Jonah Coleman (first game back) led Broncos backfield: 50% snaps, 41% rush share, 34% routes. Dobbins only 21% snaps; RJ Harvey one fluky long receiving TD. Clear LOVE/upgrade.
items.why: Immediate snap/rush/route lead post-return over Dobbins/Harvey
items.implication: Coleman primary back; downgrade Dobbins share, fade fluky Harvey TD

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring, also purposeful slide attempt per replies) — Levitan thinks actually hurt but not certain. ETR watching with Tracy.
items.why: Actual injury appearance despite slide context
items.implication: Monitor for limited role or miss; Giants RB depth thins with Tracy also hamstring

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but Levitan: almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if serious from correct non-scoring slide. ETR watching list.
items.why: Purposeful slide mechanics; low concern post-game
items.implication: No expected absence; maintain RB1 ranking/usage

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT (high-ankle sprain context); continues multi-week absence with pain on cuts/sprints noted in follow-ups. Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Week 8 return possible but practice-dependent; Ravens offense limited

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; Eagles WR room thinned for MNF (Lemon bet interest noted elsewhere).
Josh Jacobs activated and expected/IN to play (ETR confirmed IN); first game back context for Packers RB.
items.implication: Immediate RB workload return; ROS value discussion ongoing

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name? (post-performance call for sustained recognition/upgrade).
items.why: Strong recent play warrants more ranking/usage respect
items.implication: Hold/start with confidence as WR2/flex; Burrow connection intact

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: arguably worst NFL runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPR ppg via 9 carries inside 5 and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume/RZ/targets overwhelm efficiency; backup in same scheme 4.9 YPC
items.implication: Sustainable floor via opportunity despite bad running; trust process over recent YPC

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; Berry advises turning big game into sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Explosion game creates trade window before regression
items.implication: Capitalize on peak value; not long-term buy signal

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Noel 15 (left early turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell only 6 (first game since 2024).
items.why: Dell limited in return; Noel early exit
items.implication: Nico locked as alpha; Dell ramp-up slow, limited immediate threat
items.opportunity: Nico routes/targets dominant; Dell handcuff watch

items.text: Chiefs WR routes (2nd game without Rashee Rice): Xavier Worthy 33 of 36 Mahomes dropbacks (near-max), then Royals 24/Armstrong 20. Note: Worthy never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games.
items.why: Rice out (hamstring); Worthy clear route leader
items.implication: High snap/route ceiling but historical yardage cap limits boom; monitor target quality
items.conflict: high routes vs career ceiling under 83 yds
